profile.Name: Agnu
profile.Job: Prisoner of the Tower of Abuse
profile.Personality: He cannot speak and only screams or growls. He flails in fury when caged, and he screams and refuses to move in Venge. Beep calls him his best friend and can calm him down.
profile.Backstory: Imprisoned in the Tower of Abuse by the Thrall Masters. His history before the tower is unknown.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Cannot form words; every line is a scream or a growl such as 'Rrgh.'
